brands.evidence: Monzo does not charge any fees for paying by card (or contactless/Apple Pay/Google Pay) in any currency abroad.

client_claims.text: Monzo does not charge any fees for paying by card in any currency abroad.
They pass Mastercard's exchange rate directly onto you with no markup.
Free plan (Monzo not main bank): £400 every 30 days in UK & EEA, £200 outside the EEA, 3% fee after allowance.
Free plan with Monzo as main bank: unlimited in UK & EEA, £200 every 30 days outside the EEA, 3% fee after.
Monzo Extra / legacy Plus: unlimited in UK & EEA; £200 (Extra) / £400 (Plus) outside the EEA.
client_claims.note: Paid plan allowances are not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: Monzo Perks / Max / legacy Premium: unlimited in UK & EEA, £600 every 30 days outside the EEA.
client_claims.note: Paid plan allowances are not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: Monzo generally counts as your main bank if you pay in at least £500 and have an active Direct Debit within a rolling 35-day period, or receive DWP/DfC benefits.
client_claims.note: Main bank criteria are not in the facts.

client_claims.text: The allowance is a rolling 30-day period, not reset on the 1st of the month.
You can check your live allowance in the app under Account > Fees and allowances.
Some overseas ATMs charge their own flat withdrawal fee, even when Monzo doesn't.
